groups.title: Volunteer meeting moved
groups.passage:
To: Community Garden Volunteers
From: Lena Ortiz, Garden Coordinator
Subject: Tuesday meeting

The volunteer meeting planned for Tuesday will take place in the library's small conference room instead of the garden shed. The shed's heating system is being repaired, and the work is expected to continue through Wednesday. Please bring the plant labels that were distributed last week. We will use them to decide which beds need new signs. The meeting will begin at 6:30 p.m. and should finish before 7:30. Afterward, anyone who has time may help move the seed trays back into the shed.

Thank you,
Lena

items.stem: Why will the meeting be held in the library?
opts: The volunteers requested a larger room.
items.expl: The notice says that the shed's heating system is being repaired, so the meeting has been moved to the library.

items.stem: What are volunteers asked to bring?
items.expl: Lena asks volunteers to bring the plant labels distributed the previous week.

items.stem: What may volunteers do after the meeting?
items.expl: The final sentence says that volunteers with time may move the seed trays back into the shed.

groups.title: A new bicycle area
groups.passage:
To: All Staff
From: Miguel Santos, Facilities
Subject: Bicycle storage
Date: May 12

Starting Monday, employees may leave bicycles in the covered area beside the west entrance. The old rack near the loading bay will be removed on Friday because delivery vehicles need more space there. A key card is not required for the covered area, but bicycles must be secured to a rack and may not block the emergency exit. Facilities will add six racks during the first week of June. Until then, please share the existing spaces and do not leave helmets on the floor. Questions about the new arrangement should be sent to Facilities before Thursday.

Miguel

opts: It is near an emergency exit.
New racks will be installed there.
items.expl: The notice explains that delivery vehicles need more space near the loading bay.

opts: It is beside the west entrance.
items.expl: The second paragraph states that the covered area is beside the west entrance.

items.stem: What should employees do until the new racks are installed?
opts: Request a key card from Facilities.
items.expl: Employees are asked to share the existing spaces until six additional racks are added in June.

groups.title: Evening workshop registration
groups.passage:
RIVERDALE LEARNING CENTER

A three-week workshop on practical spreadsheet skills will begin on September 4. Classes will meet on Wednesday evenings from 7:00 to 8:30 in Room 204. Participants should bring a laptop with a spreadsheet program installed. The center will provide practice files and a printed reference guide. Registration is limited to eighteen people, and places are assigned in the order that complete forms are received. The fee includes all three sessions. To request an accessibility arrangement, contact the center at least one week before the first class.

Registration desk hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.

At least one week before the first class

The Maple Court Hotel's second-floor meeting rooms will be unavailable on Tuesday from 6:00 to 11:00 a.m. while the carpets are cleaned. CITY HISTORY MUSEUM

The west gallery will close from November 3 through November 10 so that a new lighting system can be installed. Visitors may still enter the museum through the main entrance and visit the east gallery, the archive display, and the museum shop. The Saturday walking tour will begin in the lobby as usual, but its final stop will be the archive display rather than the west gallery. Tickets purchased for the west-gallery evening talk may be exchanged for a talk on November 17. To arrange an exchange, contact the events desk by November 8.

STAFF DEVELOPMENT UPDATE

Employees who attended the customer-service workshop on April 6 are asked to complete the online feedback form by April 12. The form takes about five minutes and includes questions about the pace of the workshop, the usefulness of the role-play activities, and topics for a future session. The training team will summarize the responses for the department meeting on April 19. Individual comments will not be linked to names in that summary. Employees who could not attend may register for the repeat workshop through the staff portal.

groups.title: Office recycling drive

OFFICE NOTICE

The Green Desk team will collect used batteries and small electronic accessories in the lobby from Monday through Wednesday. Collection boxes will be available beside the visitor sign-in table. Please place batteries in a separate bag and remove personal labels from old accessories before dropping them off. The team cannot accept large appliances, printer cartridges, or liquids. A summary of the amount collected will be posted on the staff noticeboard next Friday. Employees who have questions about acceptable items should email Green Desk before bringing them to the lobby.
